_about: OBS 側 DLL（streaming/obs-multi-rtmp ブランチ k4-thin。master に入れたらコミットを書く）の vendor API「obs-multi-rtmp」の契約の写し。名前・引数・答えの形だけ。apiVersion は 3。DLL 側を変えたらここも変える（test/k4-obs-contract.test.js が丸ストの使う名前と突き合わせ、DLL のソースが隣にあれば kRequests とも突き合わせる）。

list_capabilities.description: Lists every vendor request this plugin registers, with a one-line description of each. Includes apiVersion and pluginVersion.

get_snapshot.description: No params (reveal_secrets is ignored/rejected). One-shot reconcile snapshot: apiVersion, pluginVersion, observedAt (UTC), headless, and targets without secrets.

list_targets.description: List every target with its id, name, protocol, state, enabled flag, and sync flags.

get_target_status.description: Params: id. Live status (state, duration, bitrate, fps, last error) for one target.

get_target_config.description: Params: id, reveal_secrets (default false). Full saved config for one target; service_settings fields matching key/token/password/secret are redacted unless reveal_secrets is true.

start_target.description: Params: id. Starts one target (no-op if disabled or already running).

stop_target.description: Params: id. Force-stops one target immediately, no confirmation dialog.

set_target_service_settings.description: Params: id, settings, merge (default true), restart_if_active (default true), dry_run (default false). Updates a target's server/key etc.; dry_run validates without applying.

set_target_enabled.description: Params: id, enabled. Enables/disables a target; disabling a live target force-stops it.

create_target.description: Params: name, protocol, service_settings, output_settings, sync_start, sync_stop, enabled (default false), dry_run (default false). Adds a new target; disabled by default until you explicitly enable it.

delete_target.description: Params: id, confirm (must be true). Deletes a target; refused if it's currently live (stop_target it first).
